selection_rule: All 12 plots of one susceptible variety; balanced as one plot per treatment in each of four blocks
selection_status: The variety was selected for low Cercospora resistance; all 12 plots were included independently of released outcomes
rights_status: Owner-authorized educational release; attribution required; complete source data not licensed
analysis_timing_note: The 2020-06-26 RGB date is two days after recorded canopy closure/inoculation timing and is the date of the first fungicide application; within-day order is unknown, so early_green_share is not a clean pretreatment baseline
release_constraints: no source plot or experiment identifiers in released tables
plot geometry represented only in preview-pixel coordinates
timeline dates released only as de-identified teaching event rows
CNN predictions use leave-one-block-out grouped cross-validation
